hero.line: From Pärnu to the Sahara and home through the Arctic: 400 days in our VW LT31 camper van.
hero.caption: Merzouga, Morocco

plan.title: A year on the road, out and back from Estonia
paragraphs: This is a lifetime goal: a long, slow camper tour of Europe and North Africa, starting and finishing at our base in Estonia.

Part one heads south through the Baltics, Central Europe and the Balkans, across Italy to Spain for La Vuelta, then Portugal, and on to Morocco for the winter, with a loop to the Sahara and a climb of Toubkal.
Part two comes home the long way through Spain, France, the Alps and Germany, in time for the Song Festival (Laulupidu) in Tallinn, then north into the Arctic and back down the Norwegian fjords.
This site is our working plan. Change the start date and every date moves with it; festivals are checked again against the new dates.

chapters_intro: Each chapter runs from one week to three months and ends where the trip changes: a ferry, a border, a season or a stop at home.
